newsitem.title: USA: Vornado Realty says to acquire $185 mln note.
newsitem.headline: Vornado Realty says to acquire $185 mln note.

text.p: Vornado Realty Trust said on Tuesday that it had agreed to acquire a mortgage note for $185 million.

The note, which is secured by a 875,000 square-feet Manhattan office building in New York, is in default, the company said in a statement. It is located at 90 Park Ave. and has a face value of $193 million, it said.
The acquisition is subject to approval by the loan participants and is expected to be completed during the second quarter of 1997, the company said.
Vornado Realty, an equity real estate investment trust, but declined to disclose who the owners were.
